content: Yahu inɣa řaǧ n Axab
Axab tuɣa ɣares sebɛin n iḥenjiren di Samarya. Yahu yura tibratin, issekk i-tent ɣar Samarya i imeqqranen n Yazraɛil, i imɣaren u i yinni yarebban iḥenjiren n Axab. Daysent inna:
“Mařa řexxu tabrat-a tusa-dd ɣarwem, am ɣarwem iḥenjiren n siditwem řa d ikarruten d yeysan, d ict n tendint ifaryen d řesnaḥ,
arzum xenni x yinni iṣebḥen d inni imeḥḍen qaɛ jar iḥenjiren n siditwem u sɣimem t x řɛarc n babas u wtem di ṭṭweɛ n taddart n siditwem.”
Maca nitni dewřen tteggʷeden aṭṭas, nnan: “Xzar, tnayen n ijeǧiden war zemmaren ad qqimen bedden zzates, mammec i ɣa nzemmar neccin ad neqqim nbedd?”

Inni iǧan x taddart u x tendint, imɣaren d yinni yarebban iḥenjiren n Axab, ssekken ijj n ureqqas ɣar Yahu, nnan: “Neccin d imsexxaren nnec, u marra min d aneɣ ɣa tinid, ad t negg. Neccin war nᵉttegg uřa d ijj d ajeǧid. Egg min tᵉttwařid nican di tiṭṭawin nnec.”

Xenni yura ɣarsen ict n tebrat i twařa wiss tnayen, inna: “Mařa aqa kenniw ɣar uɣezdis inu, ad tesřem ɣar min ɣa iniɣ, ksim xenni izeǧifen n iḥenjiren n siditwem, u asem-dd tiwecca ammu ɣar řweqt-a ɣari di Yazraɛil.” Iḥenjiren n ujeǧid, sebɛin n yeryazen, tuɣa zeddɣen ɣar imcennɛen n tendint, inni ten yarebban.
Umi ɣarsen dd-tiweḍ tebrat, imsar, belli nitni ṭṭfen iḥenjiren n ujeǧid, nɣin ten marra, sebɛin n yeryazen. Nitni ggin izeǧifen nsen di řkurbat uca ssekken tent ɣares ɣar Yazraɛil.
Yusa-dd umsexxar, issiweḍ areqqas, inna: “Aqa iwyen-dd izeǧifen n iḥenjiren n ujeǧid.” Netta yarra-dd: “Sarsem ten ař tiwecca di tnayen n iɛurrac ɣar wadaf n tewwart.”
Ɣar tiwecca, umi iffeɣ ɣar barra, imsar, aqa ibedd din, inna i marra řgens: “Kenniw d imseggaden. Xzarem, d necc i iggin ict n tmeɛmuč x sidi inu u nɣiɣ t. Maca wi inɣin marra ina?
Snem, aqa war iweṭṭi ɣar temmurt uřa d ijj n wawař n SIDI nni inna SIDI ḍidd i taddart n Axab, maɣar SIDI igga min tuɣa inna s uqemmum n umsexxar nnes Ilicaɛ.”
Yahu inɣa marra wi iqqimen zi taddart n Axab di Yazraɛil uřa d marra imcennɛen nnes d imeddukkař nnes d ikehhanen nnes, ařami war ijji ad zzayes iqqim uřa d ijj n umarweř.
Xenni ikkar uca iṭṭef abrid ɣar Samarya. Umi t tuɣa netta deg webrid, imsar di taddart n umeřqi n imeksawen,
aqa immeřqa Yahu ak-d awmaten n Axazya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, inna: “Min teɛnam kenniw?” Nitni arrin-dd: “Neccin d awmaten n Axazya u nehwa-dd, ḥima ad nseǧem x iḥenjiren n ujeǧid d iḥenjiren n tjeǧidt.”
Xenni inna: “Ṭṭfem ten ddaren!” Ṭṭfen ten ddaren u nɣin ten ɣar wanu n taddart n imeksawen. Tuɣa-ten di tnayen u arebɛin n yeryazen. War ijji uřa d ijj zzaysen iddar.

Netta iffeɣ ssenni uca yufa Yunadab, mmis n Rikab, wenni dd-iffɣen i umsagar akides. Netta iseǧem xas, inna as: “Ma uř nnec iseggem akidi am mammec iseggem wuř inu akidek?” Yunadab yarra-dd xas: “Amenni, amenni! Ewc ayi-dd afus nnec.” Netta iwca as afus uca ijja i-t ad dd-iniy ɣares deg ukarru.
Netta inna: “As-dd akidi uca ad tẓared asam inu i SIDI.” Ammu i jjin t ad dd-iniy akides deg ukarru.
Umi yiweḍ ɣar Samarya, inɣa netta marra inni tuɣa iqqimen n Axab di Samarya, ařami t iqḍa qaɛ am mammec inna wawař n SIDI nni tuɣa inna i Ilicaɛ.
Yahu iqḍa x weɛbed n Baɛal
Yahu issmun marra řgens uca inna asen: “Axab tuɣa isexxar i Baɛal cwayt, maca Yahu ad as isexxar aṭṭas ɛad.

Xenni řexxu, řaɣam-dd x marra inabiyyen n Baɛal d marra imsexxaren nnes d marra ikehhanen nnes, maḥend ad ɣari dd-asen. Ḥḍam aqa ad iqqim ḥed, minzi ɣari ict n tɣarṣt d tameqqrant i Baɛal. Marra wi ɣa iɣaben, war ittɣimi iddar.” Yahu maca igga ta s tḥraymect, maḥend ad iqḍa x imsexxaren n Baɛal.
Xas uca inna Yahu: “Sqeddsem ijj n umuni ifarzen i Baɛal!” Uca nitni barrḥen i man aya.
Issekk Yahu ireqqasen di marra Israil u marra imsexxaren n Baɛal usin-dd, war iqqim uřa d ijj war dd-yusi. Nitni udfen ɣar zzawect n Baɛal ařami teccur zzawect n Baɛal zi ṭṭarf ař ṭṭarf.
Xenni inna i wenni iǧan x wexxam n warruḍ: “Awi-dd arruḍen i marra imsexxaren n Baɛal!” U wanita yiwi asen-dd arruḍen.
Yudef Yahu ak-d Yunadab, mmis n Rikab, ɣar zzawect n Baɛal u netta inna i imsexxaren n Baɛal: “Xzarem mliḥ, aqa war ɣarwem ittiři uřa d ijj zeg imsexxaren n SIDI, mɣir imsexxaren n Baɛal waha.”

Umi iwḍen, maḥend ad din awyen tiɣarṣa d tɣarṣa n wecmaḍ, tuɣa issbedd Yahu tmenyin n yeryazen i yixef nnes di barra, inna: “Zeg weryaz nni i ɣa yejj ad injem ijj zeg yeryazen nni ggiɣ deg ifassen nwem, ad idweř řeɛmar nnes deg wemcan n řeɛmar nni.”

Řami iqfeř usewjed n tɣarṣṭ n wecmaḍ, imsar belli netta inna i ireqqasem n tazřa u i řqebṭanat: “Adfem, wtem ten, war ttejjim uřa d ijj ad injem!” Nitni nɣin ten s řeqḍeɛ n ssif u řqebṭanat nḍaren ten barra. Nitni udfen ɣar uř n zzawect n Baɛal.
Nitni kksen imayḍuten iqeddsen zi zzawect n Baɛal uca ssarɣen ten.
Nitni arẓin ameyḍa iqeddsen n Baɛal. Hedmen ɛawed zzawect n Baɛal uca ggin tt d ict n tzubact ař ass-a.
Ammu i imḥa Yahu Baɛal zi Israil.
Maca Yahu war ibedd zeg weḍfar n ddnub n Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, wenni yarrin Israil ad ixḍa: iɛejmiyyen n wureɣ nni iǧan di Bayt-Il.
SIDI inna i Yahu: “Minzi teggid nican umi teggid min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin inu, uca teggid ak-d taddart n Axab marra min ɣari deg wuř, ad qqimen iḥenjiren nwem x řɛarc n Israil ař jjiř wiss arebɛa.”
Maca Yahu war iḥḍi ca maḥend ad yuyur ɛlaḥsab Ccariɛa n SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, s marra uř nnes. Netta war iḥeyyed x ddnub n Yarubɛam wenni yarrin Israil ad ixḍa.
Deg wussan nni ibda SIDI ad issemẓi Israil. Ḥazayil iwta i-ten di marra tammurt n Israil,
zi L’Urdun manis dd-tneqqar tfuct, marra tammurt n Jilɛad, tammurt n Ijadiyyen d Irubiniyyen d Imanassiyyen, zi Aruɛir wenni iǧan ɣar teɣzart n Arnun, uřa d Jilɛad d Bacan.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Yahu, d marra min igga d marra timegga nnes imeḥḍen, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Israil?
Yahu igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Neḍřen t di Samarya. Mmis Yahuyaḥaz idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Ussan i di tuɣa Yahu iḥekkem di Samarya aqa aten di tmenya u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa.
